The bank raised its price target to $18 from $12 (~66% upside based on Sept. 18 close).
A BLA for the immunotherapy is on schedule for a Q4 submission, noted analyst Alec Stranahan, who added the company has a healthy $201.6M in cash.
Stranahan wrote he projects probability-adjusted sales of $1B total for Candel in 2035.

Candel also has linoserpaturev (CAN-3110), a replication-competent herpes simplex virus designed to selectively kills cancer cells, in phase 1 for brain cancer. The candidate has FDA Fast Track and Orphan Drug designations.

title: Candel upgraded at BofA on prostate cancer gene therapy
